name: Convert callback to async/await Promise API
description: Modernize readFileCallback into an async/await Promise function readTextFileAsync in src/reader.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Modernize the legacy callback API in src/reader.ts by implementing and exporting readTextFileAsync(path: string): Promise<string>. It should return a Promise that resolves with the file content, or rejects with an Error if the path is invalid or empty. Keep the existing callback function for backwards compatibility.

acceptance_criteria: readTextFileAsync returns a Promise resolving to string
Rejects with Error when path is empty
